answer: Stop sybils with a mesa falcon jetty: an agent bonds one mesa flat. Each cycle it flies one falcon from its mesa to its jetty; verifiers match the falcon's tether sag to the mesa chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 mesas at 19x: one falcon flies once from one mesa, its sag set by that flight alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents fly once, keep rights.
